generated_for: Savage Surfboards official named standup catalog
source: https://www.savagesurfboards.com/models.html (official 2026 models lineup only — excludes shop one-off inventory SKUs, ding repair, custom deposits, fins, and merch)

brands.name: Savage Surfboards
brands.short_description: Handcrafted East Coast surfboards from Kenny Briel and Shawn O'Donnell in Wilmington, North Carolina — performance shortboards, grovelers, fish, and longboards built in the USA since 1982.

models.name: Jason Motes / Iron Man
models.description: Made for champions. Modeled for Jason Motes who has 30+ National Championship titles. Today's performance with a bit of 80's influence. Ideal wave size: knee to chest high. Sized 5'0–6'8.

models.name: Mush Burger
models.description: The Mush Burger is a favorite of Savage Team Riders. A high-performance board designed for advanced-level surfers to excel in heavier East-Coast conditions. Performance rocker with a single-to-double concave allows this board to excel in the pocket. Ideal wave size: knee to chest high. Sized 4'8–6'8.

models.name: Creature
models.description: A groveler with increased volume in the chest for a blend of performance and added paddle power. Perfect contest board for when the conditions aren't 100% ideal. Ideal wave size: knee-high to overhead. Sized 4'8–6'6.

models.name: Mantis
models.description: Our take on the traditional fish shape. Wide outline with an updated single-to-double concave to ensure paddle power and maneuverability on waves of all sizes. Ideal wave size: knee to chest high. Sized 5'0–6'8.

models.name: Clinger
models.description: Our Mantis shape with a shorter rail line and rocket tail, giving the board a looser feel. Custom order only. Ideal wave size: shin to chest high. Sized 5'0–6'6.

models.name: Big Rat
models.description: Our take on a performance groveler with a pulled in tail that gives advanced surfers a looser pivot point on carves and top-to-bottom maneuvers. Ideal wave size: knee to chest high. Sized 5'0–6'6.

models.name: Predator
models.description: Want to bring your skate style to the ocean? The Predator is your go-to. Our swallow-tail, channel bottom design offers a responsive ride that performs best in medium surf, but has enough go to flow down the line on smaller days. The snub nose creates a straighter drawn out rail, which increases speed and decreases drag and allows for tighter surfing in the pocket. Custom order only. Ideal wave size: knee-high to shoulder. Sized 5'4–6'4.

models.name: Egg Beater
models.description: More-than-your-average funboard! A great option for younger riders starting to advance their surfing or older guys looking to get more performance out of a bigger board. Ideal wave size: knee-high to overhead. Sized 6'10–7'10.

models.name: Bootlegger
models.description: A fun board with performance shortboard rockers and today's concave for the surfer looking for paddle power while maintaining a maneuverability and drive. Ideal wave size: knee-high to overhead. Sized 6'6–6'10.

models.name: Salted Sow
models.description: The Salted Sow is our tried-and-true noserider model. Everybody loves bacon. Ideal wave size: ankle to chest high. Sized 9'0–10'0.

models.name: Orange Blossom Special
models.description: Our all-around longboard, perfect balance of performance and noserider. Ideal wave size: ankle to chest high. Sized 9'0–9'8.

models.name: California Classic
models.description: A traditional California noserider with a flatter rocker for East Coast waves. Ideal wave size: ankle to chest high. Sized 9'6–10'0.
